Meridian opens A$180 million pump plant in Adelaide

Media release · {{DATE}} · Sydney

Meridian Industrial Group (ASX: MIG) today opened a A$180 million manufacturing plant at Tonsley, Adelaide, that will build variable-speed pumps for water utilities in Australia and South-East Asia. The plant will employ 320 people at full production in two years.

Chief Executive Officer Helena Marsh said the plant doubles the group's pump capacity and brings production closer to its largest customers. The site runs on rooftop solar and recycles all process water.

About Meridian Industrial Group

Meridian Industrial Group designs and manufactures pumps, valves and control systems for water utilities, energy producers and infrastructure builders in 14 countries. Founded in Sydney in 1962 and listed on the ASX, it employs 12,400 people across 22 plants.
